title: Validating and parsing
description:
Write four functions with `string.match` and patterns:

```lua-norun
trim(s)               -- s without spaces, tabs and newlines at either end
is_identifier(s)      -- true when s is a valid Lua name: a letter or _, then letters, digits or _
parse_time(s)         -- "HH:MM" (hour with 1 or 2 digits, minutes with exactly 2) -> two numbers, hour and minute;
                      -- nil when the text is not in that form or the hour is over 23 or the minutes over 59
parse_setting(line)   -- "key = value" -> key, value, both trimmed; the key is an identifier, the value anything
                      -- (it may be empty); nil when the line has no = or the key is not an identifier
```

```lua-norun
parse_time("9:05")                   --> 9, 5
parse_time("24:00")                  --> nil
parse_setting("  volume = 11 ")      --> "volume", "11"
parse_setting("title=My Game")       --> "title", "My Game"
```

Do not check whether `is_identifier` names a reserved word.

solution.solution.lua:
function trim(s)
    return (s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
end

function is_identifier(s)
    return s:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") ~= nil
end

function parse_time(s)
    local h, m = s:match("^(%d%d?):(%d%d)$")
    if not h then return nil end
    h, m = tonumber(h), tonumber(m)
    if h > 23 or m > 59 then return nil end
    return h, m
end

function parse_setting(line)
    local key, value = line:match("^%s*([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if not key then return nil end
    return key, value
end

hints: Anchor every pattern with `^` and `$` so that nothing else may come before or after.
`%d%d?` is one digit followed by an optional second one. Captures are strings: convert them with `tonumber` before comparing.
unitTests:
test("trim", function()
    check_eq(trim("  padded  "), "padded")
    check_eq(trim("\t tabs and\nnewlines \n"), "tabs and\nnewlines")
    check_eq(trim("none"), "none")
    check_eq(trim("   "), "")
end)

test("identifiers", function()
    check(is_identifier("player_1"), "player_1")
    check(is_identifier("_hidden"), "_hidden")
    check(not is_identifier("1player"), "1player starts with a digit")
    check(not is_identifier("my-name"), "my-name has a minus")
    check(not is_identifier(""), "the empty string")
    check(not is_identifier("a b"), "a space")
end)

test("valid times", function()
    check_eq({ parse_time("9:05") }, { 9, 5 })
    check_eq({ parse_time("23:59") }, { 23, 59 })
    check_eq({ parse_time("00:00") }, { 0, 0 })
    check_eq(math.type(parse_time("12:30")), "integer")
end)

test("invalid times", function()
    check_eq(parse_time("24:00"), nil)
    check_eq(parse_time("12:60"), nil)
    check_eq(parse_time("12:5"), nil)
    check_eq(parse_time("123:45"), nil)
    check_eq(parse_time("12:345"), nil)
    check_eq(parse_time(" 9:05"), nil)
    check_eq(parse_time("nine"), nil)
end)

test("settings", function()
    check_eq({ parse_setting("  volume = 11 ") }, { "volume", "11" })
    check_eq({ parse_setting("title=My Game") }, { "title", "My Game" })
    check_eq({ parse_setting("empty =") }, { "empty", "" })
    check_eq({ parse_setting("path = a=b") }, { "path", "a=b" })
    check_eq(parse_setting("no equals sign"), nil)
    check_eq(parse_setting("2bad = x"), nil)
end)
